name: Image Stitcher
description: Combine multiple images into one, or produce a paginated contact sheet PDF with labels
help: Everything runs locally; files never leave your computer.
Images are stitched in the order added; use move up / down to rearrange them.
Contact sheets paginate by paper size: images fit entirely in their cells, numbering runs continuously, and the result is a multi-page PDF.
Labels use the standard PDF font (ASCII only) unless you provide a TTF/OTF font file for non-Latin names or notes.
